noProject.description: Please select a project before viewing this server.

layout.noPowerPermission: You do not have permission to control power.

highUsage.cpuAndRamTitle: CPU and memory usage are high
highUsage.cpuAtLimit: CPU is at {{percent}}% of its limit.
highUsage.ramAtLimit: Memory is at {{percent}}% of its limit.
highUsage.resourceWarning: The server may become unresponsive or be killed if it runs out of resources.

toasts.statsConnectFailed: Failed to connect to server stats

backups.description: Manage server backups, restore points, and downloads.

limit.label: {{used}} of {{limit}} backups used
limit.bypassTooltip: Your permissions let you create backups beyond this server's limit.
limit.reached: The backup limit is reached. Delete a backup before creating another one.

createDialog.title: Create Backup
createDialog.description: This will start creating a new backup using the default storage.
createDialog.nameHelp: A named backup is easier to find later. Without one it is listed by its time.

restoreDialog.title: Restore backup?
restoreDialog.description: This will restore {{name}}. Existing data may be overwritten.

fileEditor.defaultDescription: Choose a file from the Files tab to open it here.
fileEditor.readOnlyNotice: You have read-only file access for this server.

noFileSelected.title: No file selected
noFileSelected.description: Open a file from the Files tab to view or edit it.

directorySelected.title: Directory selected
directorySelected.description: Directories cannot be opened in the editor.

archiveDisabled.title: Archive editing is disabled
archiveDisabled.description: This file is an archive. Download or extract it from the Files tab instead of editing it as text.

toasts.tooLarge: The file is larger than the {{limit}} upload limit

networkPorts.description: Every port exposed for this server. Raw ports are reached by host and port, HTTP ports through a route.
networkPorts.empty: No network ports are configured for this server.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Point a subdomain at one of this server's ports.
routes.subdomainInvalid: Only lowercase letters, digits and dashes are allowed.

empty.noDomains: No domains are available for this project yet.
empty.noRoutablePorts: None of this server's ports can be routed yet.

manualDns.title: Point your own domain here
manualDns.description: The records to drop into your own DNS to reach a port. Pick the port and copy them over.
manualDns.noPorts: This server has no ports yet.
manualDns.createRouteFirst: Create a route for this port first — your own domain then points at it.
manualDns.replaceHelp: Replace your-domain with the name you own.
manualDns.httpHelp: An HTTP port is served through the reverse proxy, so your domain points at the route's address.
manualDns.nonHttpHelp: Clients that look the service up find the port on their own, so nobody has to type it.

dialog.title: New route
dialog.description: Pick a subdomain, the domain it lives under and the port it points at.
dialog.httpRouteHelp: An HTTP port becomes a reverse-proxied resource on the subdomain.
dialog.rawRouteHelp: A raw port gets an SRV record on the subdomain.
dialog.noSelectablePorts: This domain cannot carry any of this server's ports yet.
dialog.httpsHelpOff: This domain does not offer HTTPS.
dialog.createsRecordHelp: Creates {{record}}, so clients that look the service up reach the port on their own. The service name comes from the port.

deleteDialog.title: Delete route
deleteDialog.description: {{fqdn}} stops resolving and its records are removed from the provider.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.description: Cron jobs the node runs against this server, without the panel needing to be online.

policyHelp.always: The steps run whatever state the server is in.
policyHelp.running: The steps are skipped unless the server is running.
policyHelp.stopped: The steps are skipped unless the server is stopped.

taskHelp.start: Starts the server and waits for it to come up.

retention.title: Retention policy
retention.description: Each counter keeps the newest backup of each of the last n periods. A backup survives as soon as one counter keeps it.
retention.limitHint: This server keeps at most {{limit}} backups.

dialog.description: Pick when the schedule fires and which steps the node runs, in order.
dialog.cronHelp: Each field takes cron syntax, for example */15, 1-5 or MON. Use * for every value.
dialog.enabledHelp: A disabled schedule is kept but never fires.
dialog.tasksHelp: Steps run top to bottom. If one fails, the remaining steps are skipped.
dialog.tooComplexForSimple: This expression is more specific than the simple editor can show. Edit it under Advanced.
dialog.weekdayHelp: Days of the week run 1-7 with Sunday as 1, or use names like MON. A plain 0 is not valid.
dialog.previewNone: This expression never fires. Check the fields marked in red.
dialog.reorder: Step {{position}} of {{total}}, drag to reorder or use the arrow keys

deleteDialog.title: Delete this schedule?
deleteDialog.description: "{{name}}" will stop running on the node. This cannot be undone.

toasts.runStarted: "{{name}}" was handed to the node. Its steps run in the background.

schedules.runUnavailable: A disabled schedule is not on the node and cannot be run

sftp.title: SFTP & SSH Access
sftp.description: Use your daemon password for SFTP password auth, or configure SSH public key auth from your profile.
sftp.sshHelpText: The quoted argument is the server name, so rename the server and this command changes with it.
sftp.helpText: Your SFTP password is the daemon password shown in your settings. You can also add SSH public keys there.

wipe.title: Wipe Server Files
wipe.description: Deletes every file on the server. The next start recreates the template's files from scratch. Stop the server first.
wipe.dialogDescription: This deletes every file of the server, including worlds and configs. This action cannot be undone.
wipe.requiresStopped: The server has to be stopped before its files can be wiped.
wipe.backupCheckboxHelp: The wipe is cancelled if the backup fails, so the files are never deleted without it.

toasts.wipeFailed: Failed to wipe the server files
toasts.wipeSuccessWithBackup: Backup started and server files wiped
toasts.commandCopyFailed: Failed to copy the SSH command

startup.title: Startup
startup.description: Edit and save server startup variables.

toasts.invalidVariables: Fix invalid startup variables before saving

warning.title: Advanced settings
warning.description: These settings control how the server process is launched. A wrong command or variable can stop the server from starting at all — only change them if you know what they do.

command.title: Startup Command
command.description: The command the server runs once its files are in place. Environment variables such as $MAIN_FILE are expanded at start.

environment.title: Environment Variables
environment.description: Custom variables passed to the server process. Names owned by the template or by a port allocation cannot be overridden.

errors.name: Use letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter or underscore
errors.reserved: This name is reserved by the template
errors.duplicate: This name is used more than once

envFile.toggleDescription: Sources the file from the server directory right before the startup command runs. Values containing spaces have to be quoted in the file.
envFile.pathHelp: Relative to the server directory, for example .env or config/production.env. A missing file is skipped.
envFile.cardDisabled: No .env file is loaded at startup.

errors.path: Use a relative path inside the server directory.

import.dialogDescription: Paste the contents of a .env file or pick one from your computer.

toasts.empty: No variables found in the pasted content
toasts.readFailed: Failed to read the selected file

toasts.loadFailed: Failed to load the startup configuration
toasts.environmentInvalid: Fix the invalid environment variables before saving
toasts.saveFailed: Failed to save the startup configuration

terminal.title: Console
terminal.typeHint: Type directly into the terminal — every keystroke is sent to the server process.
terminal.readOnlyHint: Read-only: you do not have permission to send input to this server.

console.commandPlaceholder: Type a command and press Enter

system.failed: Could not open a console session.

variablesEditor.invalidFormat: Value does not match the required format.

licenses.title: Licenses
licenses.description: Agreements this server's game requires before it may be run.
licenses.noticeHint: This server cannot be started until the agreement has been accepted.
licenses.confirmLabel: I have read and agree to the {{license}}
licenses.noPermission: Someone with power permissions for this server has to accept the agreement.

tasks.busyStorage: The server's files are locked by another task: {{task}}
